reuse.why: Adds one guard used by all five provider link functions alongside the existing linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, though it could have lived in the link.ts module with those helpers.

duplication.why: The check itself exists once; each provider repeats the call and its provider literal, which linkBankSyncAccount also receives as account_sync_source.

placement.why: Sits in accounts/app.ts next to linkBankSyncAccount; the bank-link helpers module (link.ts) would be the more natural home, and the call is per provider rather than inside the shared link flow (justified by running before findOrCreateBank).

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and tests are added.

maintainability.why: One definition of the rule, but a new provider must remember to call it since it is not part of linkBankSyncAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers still go through linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank; the guard is added in front of them.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; only one-line calls are repeated.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts holds the rule (same provider + account id, not tombstoned, not the upgrading account) and is called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
